_meta.rationale: About-team title element is .at__title. The :root override forces --ds-font-display to Inter. Phase 3.2 strips photo avatars; assertion checks no child inside .at__member. Negative trademark scan covers slug=openai strip targets.
gaps: No source-of-truth file pins per-brand --ds-radius-full hex; computed_css palette assertion deferred.

assertions.evaluate: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('.at__title'); if (!el) return false; const fam = window.getComputedStyle(el).fontFamily || ''; return fam.toLowerCase().includes('inter'); })()

(() => { const html = document.documentElement.outerHTML.toLowerCase(); const forbidden = ['openai.com/logo', 'openai-logo', 'openai-wordmark', 'openai.svg', '/logo.svg', '/wordmark.svg', '/brand/logo']; return forbidden.every(s => !html.includes(s)); })()
(() => { const members = document.querySelectorAll('.at__member'); if (members.length === 0) return false; for (const m of members) { if (m.querySelector('img')) return false; } return true; })()
